_comment: ILLUSTRATIVE SEED SCENARIO. All rates and quantities are realistic placeholders, not market quotes. Edit before using in any real engagement. Vertex Retail is a fictional client.

phases.name: Discovery
phases.description: Current-state assessment, target architecture, scope confirmation

phases.name: Design
phases.description: Solution design, integration design, security review

phases.name: Hypercare
phases.description: Post-go-live stabilization and KT to run team

scenarios.name: Base Case
scenarios.description: Recommended sourcing mix: ~30% onshore, ~25% nearshore, ~45% offshore. Mid-confidence cloud sizing pending Discovery findings.

resources.name: TBD
resources.notes: Single point of accountability across all phases.
2 senior engineers, allocation expressed as combined FTE (200%).

cloudLineItems.description: Prod application tier - reserved for predictable load.
Dev + test instances - on-demand for elasticity.
AKS node pool for analytics workload (multi-cloud per client constraint).
Bundled observability spend - logs, metrics, traces.

otherCostLineItems.name: Onshore SME travel
otherCostLineItems.notes: Discovery + go-live trips. 8 trips at ~$4.5K each.

assumptions.description: Assuming 45% offshore (India) for Build and Test phases. This requires client comfort with offshore for non-PII workloads. Switch to onshore-only mode adds ~$1.4M.
EC2 / AKS instance counts based on industry benchmarks for similar-scale e-commerce platforms. Refine after Discovery workload analysis.
Reserved 1yr commitment for prod EC2 + RDS + AKS. Saves ~30% vs on-demand but requires client purchase commitment at deploy time.
Standard mid-confidence contingency. Bump to 12% if client refuses fixed scope on integration components.

scenarios.name: Onshore-Only (Conservative)
scenarios.description: Compliance-driven variant: zero offshore. Higher price, simpler approval. Useful for risk-averse client conversations.
